name: Toshiba Tec Corporation
summary: Toshiba Tec Corporation, a key affiliate of Toshiba Corporation, specializes in delivering comprehensive retail and printing solutions across a wide global footprint. Its extensive operations serve markets in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, Oceania, the Middle East, and Africa. The company's business is strategically structured into two main divisions: Retail Solutions and Printing Solutions. Within its Retail Solutions segment, Toshiba Tec provides a complete suite of hardware and accompanying software. This encompasses essential Point-of-Sale (POS) systems, various peripherals, self-checkout machines, and interactive kiosks and displays. These hardware offerings are supported by a range of software, including POS applications, operating systems, middleware, and advanced system management tools. The Printing Solutions segment offers a diverse portfolio of printing equipment, such as desktop, mobile, and industrial-grade printers, alongside specialized inkjet head products. It also supplies versatile multifunction peripheral (MFP) devices available in color, monochrome, and hybrid configurations. Complementing its hardware, this segment delivers innovative paper reusing systems, mobile and cloud-based services, comprehensive document management solutions, and managed IT services. Beyond these core areas, the company also provides advanced digital signage solutions and offers expert engineering manufacturing services. Toshiba Tec Corporation was established in 1950 and maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
